keyVerseDR: "Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women." (Lk 1:28)

level1.title: Mary, Full of Grace
level1.story: The angel Gabriel came to Mary. He said, "Hail, full of grace! The Lord is with you." Mary said yes to God. God kept Mary free from sin from the very start!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did the angel say to Mary?
How can you keep your heart pure?
level1.prayer: Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us. Amen.

level2.title: Full of Grace
level2.story: God sent the angel Gabriel to Nazareth, to a virgin named Mary. The angel said, "Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women." He said she would bear a son and call Him Jesus, the Son of the Most High. Mary asked how, and the angel said, "The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee." Mary said, "Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it done to me according to thy word."
level2.keyLine: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How is the Immaculate Conception different from the Virgin Birth?
How does grace help you say yes to God?
actions: Pray for my country (Mary, patroness of the US)
level2.prayer: O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee. Amen.
